audit_items.proof_trace: The derived field `max_blobs_by_root_request` is computed once at initialization from pre-Electra value (768) and never refreshed when Electra fork activates (which should use 1152). RPC validation uses this stale limit instead of the dynamic `max_request_blob_sidecars(fork)` method, causing incorrect request validation post-fork.
audit_items.attack_scenario: After Electra fork activation, a malicious peer sends a BlobsByRoot request with 769-1152 blob identifiers. The stale limit (768) incorrectly rejects this valid post-Electra request, causing DoS by preventing legitimate blob sync. Conversely, if limit decreased across forks, oversized requests would be accepted.
